list.name: Mio
list.text: The Lantern Post is cold and dark… Granny said it would wake for the Lantern.
Mio lifts the Lantern. The wick catches, and the post blooms with pale light.

list.name: Tip
list.text: Lantern Posts: rest, save, and Shift for free nearby. Now press Q (or Tab) to Shift to the Far Shore!
An old Lantern Post. Its wick burned down to ash long ago. There is a working Post elsewhere on this road.
An old Lantern Post. Its wick burned down to ash long ago. There is a working Post elsewhere on this road.

then.name: Mio
then.text: Ashiro Well. Cold air breathes up from below, and a rope ladder trails into the dark.

then.name: Mio
then.text: The path past the boulder still feels watched. I should clear the Far Shore corridor first.

list.name: Mio
list.text: A huge boulder, wedged tight. It won’t budge.

then.name: Kaze
then.text: Rock’s only a rock on this shore. Over on the Far Shore it isn’t even there. Shift, walk past, shift back. Easy.

else.name: Mio
else.text: (The air feels thin here… as if the Far Shore is pressing close. Maybe the Lantern can help.)

list.text: Tip: obstacles can exist on only one shore. Shift (Q), walk past, then Shift back.

list.name: Mio
list.text: A huge boulder, wedged tight. It won’t budge.

then.text: Rock’s only a rock on this shore. Over on the Far Shore it isn’t even there. Shift, walk past, shift back. Easy.

else.text: (The air feels thin here… as if the Far Shore is pressing close. Maybe the Lantern can help.)

list.text: A huge boulder, wedged tight. It won’t budge.

list.text: Tip: obstacles can exist on only one shore. Shift (Q), walk past, then Shift back.

else.name: Mio
else.text: (I should talk to Granny first.)

then.name: Daigo
then.text: The forge’s cold, but I’ll get it going again. Soon as the Bell rings.

else.text: The forge door is barred from inside. A note: “Gone to the Well. — D.”

list.text: The Elder’s door is shut. He’s standing outside, as usual.
Kiku’s family is at the festival grounds. The door is latched.
Nobody home. A lantern hangs unlit by the door.

then.name: Gate Guard
then.text: Halt. No one climbs to the Shrine after dusk without the Elder’s seal. Orders.

then.name: Mio
then.text: Elder Matsu has one for us, I think. Let’s ask him.

then.name: Kaze
then.text: Mio. The spirits up there bite harder than the ones down here. A few more fights on the Far Shore first wouldn’t hurt. (Recommended Lv 5)
The Shrine Key turns with a soft chime. The Guard checks the Elder’s seal and waves you through. The gate swings open.

else.text: The Shrine gate is locked tight. Its keyhole is shaped like a bell.

then.name: Mio
then.text: (I shouldn’t climb alone. That fox on the Far Shore by the square post… I should find him first.)

then.name: Kaze
then.text: Mio. The spirits up there bite harder than the ones down here. A few more fights on the Far Shore first wouldn’t hurt. (Recommended Lv 5)
The Shrine Key turns with a soft chime. The gate swings open.

else.text: The Shrine gate is locked tight. Its keyhole is shaped like a bell.

list.name: Gate Guard
list.text: Up to the Shrine? Not without the Elder’s seal, miss. Not after dusk. Though the wind says the other shore has no guards…

then.name: Gate Guard
then.text: Ah, the seal. All in order. Go on.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: Ah, Sachi’s girl. So you have the Lantern at last. Light the post in the square, then press Q and look through the Lantern, there by the post. Someone on the Far Shore has been waiting for you. Come back to me after.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: A fox, you say? Hm. Then the Lantern has chosen well.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: Listen. The Shrine Bell has not rung since Priest Ren left us. Without it, no Lantern will light, and the spirits grow restless.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: The gate to the Shrine is locked, and the key was lost down Ashiro Well. Long ago, they say the Well Spirit took it.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: The path to the Well is blocked by a boulder, since the last storm. Our young ones can’t shift it. But you… well. You carry a Lantern.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: Take my seal; the guard at the Shrine gate answers to it. Show him, and he will let you pass.
The Well. The one place Granny Sachi said, her whole life, never to go.

opts: Wait. Sit with Granny a moment first

br.name: Mio
br.text: Then I’ll go now, before I think about it.
Mio goes back to the little house and sits by the bed. Sachi’s breath is slow and even, and the hearth is cold.

br.name: Mio
br.text: I’m scared, Granny. …But you’d tell me to go.
Sachi doesn’t answer. Mio closes her fingers around the Lantern, and walks back out into the dusk.

then.name: Kaze
then.text: Boulder, Well, key. Sounds like a morning stroll. Let’s go.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: The key! Then climb, children. The Bell has waited long enough.

then.name: Elder Matsu
then.text: The Well lies past the boulder, south-west. Mind your Lumen on the Far Shore.

else.name: Elder Matsu
else.text: Daigo’s safe at the forge? Good lad. Now find that key.

list.text: NOTICE — Dust Wisps drift through the north fields on the Far Shore. Calm or clear 4 of them. Reward: a Hush Bell pair and 60 gold.

br.text: Tip: wisps only walk the Far Shore (Shift with Q). In battle, Parley raises a spirit’s Mood (Soothe at Lv 2); at full Mood, Send (Lv 3) gives a kinder end.

then.text: The bounty is complete.
Four wisps calmed or cleared. You hand in the notice.

else.text: Progress: wisps calmed or cleared — keep walking the north fields on the Far Shore (Shift with Q).

list.name: Villager
list.text: Tonight’s the Lantern Festival, and not one lantern will light! Granny Sachi’s girl just got hers, though. That’s a start.

then.name: Aunt Fumi
then.text: Daigo’s back, safe and sooty! You pulled him out of that Well, Mio. Eat something, you two.

else.name: Aunt Fumi
else.text: Daigo’s gone off to the Well this morning, looking for the old bell clapper. He’s stubborn like his father. Someone should look for him.

list.name: Boy
list.text: I saw a fox! Just for a second, sitting by the post. Then — poof! — I blinked and it was gone.

then.name: Kiku
then.text: My wind-chime!! You found it!

then.name: Kiku
then.text: It was hanging in a tree I can’t even see! Thank you thank you thank you!

then.name: Kiku
then.text: It sings in the wind again. Sometimes it sings back, when nobody’s listening.

then.name: Kiku
then.text: Please find my chime! Granny says things that fall into the Far Shore don’t come back, but you can go there!

else.name: Kiku
else.text: My wind-chime is gone! It was Grandpa’s. I was swinging it and—it just flew off, and sparkled, and then it was gone.

else.name: Mio
else.text: I’ll look for it. Somewhere only the Lantern can see, maybe.

list.name: Kaze
list.text: Oh. You can see me. Of course — that Lantern. Hello, Lantern-bearer.

list.name: Mio
list.text: You’re a fox. On the Far Shore. Talking.

list.name: Kaze
list.text: Spirit fox, if you please. Kaze. I’ve been waiting at that post for forty years for someone to light it and notice me.

list.name: Kaze
list.text: Word on this shore: the Bell’s gone silent, and that means trouble for both worlds. You’re headed up the Shrine, aren’t you? Then I’m coming.

list.name: Mio
list.text: Fine. But try not to be sarcastic about everything.

list.name: Kaze
list.text: No promises.
Kaze joined! Hit weaknesses for Echo bonuses. Spirits you meet are recorded in the Bestiary once Granny Sachi gives you her Ledger.

then.name: Old Shiro
then.text: He said that? The boat’s still tied at the third post… and he never stopped looking.

then.name: Old Shiro
then.text: Hm. That is enough. Take this, child. Ghosts don’t need charms.

else.name: Old Shiro
else.text: Thank you. Tell Hanzo he can finally mend that net.

else.name: Old Shiro
else.text: You… can see me? Then listen. There’s a fisherman, Hanzo, in the Near village.

else.name: Old Shiro
else.text: Tell him the net is finally mended, and that I forgive him for the storm. Please.

list.name: Spirit Girl
list.text: The Lantern posts are my favorite. They’re like little stars that stayed.

list.name: Wandering Spirit
list.text: The Bell would sing me home, if it still rang. I don’t mind waiting. I just… don’t want to wait forever.
A wind-chime hangs from a branch that exists only on this shore. It tinkles faintly.
A pilgrim stands in a grey robe. Their face is blank. Not hostile, only… emptied. Something might reach them, if you knew a name to whisper.
Field spells: Menu → Skill → pick a Field spell when you stand beside a target. (Mio learns Name Whisper at Lv 6.)

fieldList.name: Pilgrim
fieldList.text: Tomo. Yes. That was a good name.

fieldList.name: Pilgrim
fieldList.text: Take the piece I kept for you. A name only fades when no one says it.

list.name: Tomo
list.text: Thank you for saying it. I will walk to the Bell now.

then.name: Daigo
then.text: You’re up early, Mio. Or you never slept. Your eyes say never.

then.name: Daigo
then.text: The Bell’s quiet and the lanterns won’t catch. Don’t tell me it’s ghosts. I’ve heard that talk all week.

then.name: Mio
then.text: …I didn’t say anything.

then.name: Daigo
then.text: You were about to. Look, if it’s the old clapper that’s gone missing, I’ll go and find it myself. Hammers fix things. Spirits don’t.

else.name: Daigo
else.text: Go on, then. Light your lamp. I’ll be at the Well, if you want proof the world is only one shape.
A scarecrow stands in the corridor — but on the Far Shore its straw shivers, and two hollow eyes open.

then.text: In its chest, one small flame burns perfectly still. No flicker, no wind. It is the only steady fire in Ashiro tonight.

then.name: Kaze
then.text: Hm. That’s a Warden. I’d feel better if we were Level 3 first. Those wisps in the fields would make good practice — and the Post in the square is a safe place to rest.

else.name: Mio
else.text: That scarecrow feels wrong. I should be stronger before I face it — Level 3, maybe. The wisps in the fields… and the Post in the square to rest.

then.name: Kaze
then.text: It’s guarding something it has forgotten. Hit it where its straw is weak. When the Veil slips it will be open to a Send.

else.name: Mio
else.text: It’s guarding something it has forgotten. Hit where the straw is weak. When the Veil slips, I can try to Send it.

win.name: Mio
win.text: Rest now. Whatever you were guarding, it’s over.
The scarecrow settles into a farmer’s name — “Gen” — and Mio says it, and it goes. The still flame goes out last, by itself.
On the straw chest hangs a neat paper seal, tied with a careful knot. Someone wrote a name on it in tidy brushstrokes, and it was not Gen’s.

then.name: Kaze
then.text: Mio. Nobody ties a knot like that by accident.

else.name: Mio
else.text: Nobody ties a knot like that by accident…

lines: Dusk. Mio sits on the rim of the Old Well, the Lantern in her lap.
Far Ashiro glows below, ghost-lit and gentle. No one speaks.

win.name: Sachi (a voice)
win.text: You are holding the lantern like a rope.
Night 2: six nights to Lantern Night.

list.text: The straw figure watches you. It seems to be waiting.

list.name: Zashiki Child
list.text: …are you the one with the light? I’m so hungry for something sweet. Everyone forgot to leave the mochi out.

then.text: Mio finds a festival Mochi wrapped in her sleeve. Granny must have tucked it there.

then.name: Tip
then.text: A shy spirit. It will never fight. Parley → Offer it the Mochi to fill its Mood, then Invite it to bond.

else.name: Tip
else.text: A shy spirit. It will never fight. Parley → Offer it the Mochi to fill its Mood. Invite (to bond) is learned at Lv 4, so come back later if you want it to stay with you.

list.name: Zashiki Child
list.text: Thank you for being kind. I’ll keep your house warm.

else.name: Mio
else.text: (The east road goes to the Forest and the Crossing. Not tonight. Not until the Bell rings.)

else.name: Mio
else.text: (The east road goes to the Forest and the Crossing. Not tonight. Not until the Bell rings.)

list.text: A festival lantern, relit when the Bell rang. Its flame leans east, toward the Forest road.
A festival lantern, relit when the Bell rang. Its flame leans east, toward the Forest road.
A festival lantern, relit when the Bell rang. Its flame leans east, toward the Forest road.

else.name: Mio
else.text: (The old reed field trail. Granny is waiting for me. I should see her first.)
